title.from: Reconcile diagnosed priority actions in optimization reports

description.from:
Ensure completed semantic diagnosis replaces stale assessment guidance in stakeholder-facing priority rows.

Feature: Diagnosed priority projection
  Scenario: A selected priority has completed diagnosis
    Given a ranked score has both deterministic assessment and completed semantic diagnosis
    When the living report projects the priority
    Then its state, rationale, and next action come from the completed diagnosis
    And it does not tell the operator to complete diagnosis again

  Scenario: A priority has not completed diagnosis
    Given a ranked score has assessment evidence but no completed diagnosis
    When the living report projects the priority
    Then the report clearly labels diagnosis as incomplete
description.to:
Distinguish a diagnosis call returning incomplete evidence from a completed semantic diagnosis, and keep its remediation guidance visible.

Feature: Semantic diagnosis completion
  Scenario: A selected diagnosis returns complete evidence
    Given semantic diagnosis completes with full coverage
    When the living report updates diagnosis coverage
    Then the completed count increases
    And the score uses the diagnosed state, rationale, and next action

  Scenario: A selected diagnosis returns incomplete evidence
    Given semantic diagnosis returns incomplete coverage or an incomplete state
    When the living report updates diagnosis coverage
    Then the completed count does not increase
    And the incomplete count increases
    And the report does not claim all selected diagnoses completed
    And the run cannot become optimization-ready
